title: Domain Recovery, Lightspeed Sync & Payments
tldr: The most urgent item is recovering the Pacific Scuba domain (registered through Squarespace/old Google Domains) so the flood of "Contact Us" leads stops going to the previous owner's inbox. Plan: have the shop create a Squarespace account and request a transfer, while the toprock team goes straight to the source (Jeff, who controls DNS) to cut friction. On the build: the Lightspeed sync is working end-to-end (auto-create customer, de-dupe, create sale SKU, tie an e-learning code). A new wrinkle — SDI can now issue e-learning codes directly through its portal, which could remove that Lightspeed inventory step; decision is to keep Lightspeed as the accounting source of truth. Next big build piece is Stripe payments (two accounts: courses + travel). Trips and rentals are deferred. A simple new Pacific Scuba Repair check-in form was scoped.
